title: Built-on showcase + a forum comparison page
notes: The homepage now showcases the open-source stack Convoro is built on (with logos), and a new Compare page shows how Convoro stacks up against Flarum, Discourse, XenForo, phpBB and Invision Community — feature by feature.

changelog.text: Homepage “Built on” section with the logos of Laravel, Vue, Inertia, Tailwind, TypeScript and Vite.
New Compare page (linked from the homepage and nav) comparing Convoro to Flarum, Discourse, XenForo, phpBB and Invision Community.
